关键词: First Amendment to Deed of Lease
主要内容: NOVAVAX, Inc. initiated negotiations with IP9 1201 Clopper Road, LLC to amend its lease agreement for approximately 147,000 square feet of facility space located at 1201 Clopper Road, Gaithersburg, Maryland. The amendment, dated August 23, 2017, allowed for the termination of the lease upon certain events. On January 3, 2018, the Landlord provided the Company its notice to terminate the lease as of February 3, 2018. The Company will pay a termination fee of approximately $5.3 million on or before the Termination Date, which it believes is less than the potential total lease and operating expense cash obligations that could have been incurred over one year. The Company expects to record total expense of approximately $1 million in the first quarter of 2018, partially offset by deferred rent expense previously recorded.
